About Us

Catalyst Funds Management is a global, diversified alternative investment firm with the mission to deliver high-quality returns for our investors.

Employees Globally

Catalyst Funds Management is focused on growing and protecting capital through various investment strategies which produce returns that are stable and independent of global stock market performance. Founded by a senior leadership team that is ex Goldman Sachs with decades of experience.

The team not only have a passion for investing in global markets, but also dedication in building relationships with our handpicked clients who bestow their faith in us. We are all about people, long-term relationships, and trust.

We are deeply passionate about building and protecting a culture of curiosity, collaboration and long-term thinking. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of performance and ethics.

Our investment strategies are designed to perform across market cycles — delivering stable, uncorrelated returns that preserve and grow capital regardless of broader market conditions.

Our Values
What guides every
decision we make.
01
Seek the Truth

We pursue the truth with rigour and independent thinking. The best ideas win on merit — not hierarchy, bias, or consensus. We question deeply, think clearly and leave no stone unturned in our search for clarity and conviction.

02
One Team

We believe collective intelligence outperforms individual brilliance. We work as one team — building trust, collaborating openly and holding ourselves accountable to deliver exceptional outcomes.

03
Think Long Term

We think and act for the long term. We prioritise enduring outcomes over short-term gains, applying discipline, tenacity and patience to achieve results that compound over time.

04
Integrity

We act with honesty, accountability and respect in every decision and interaction — especially when it is difficult. We build trust through our actions and safeguard our reputation relentlessly.
